get.description: Long-poll the live picture: returns as soon as something changed, or after ``wait`` seconds.
Bounded spatial query: features inside lon/lat bbox (WGS84, lon first), capped by limit.
History for replay over a window, separate from the live picture and capped in total.

get.description:
SSE of the change journal. Resumes from Last-Event-ID (or ``cursor``); ``reset`` asks for a reload.

Locked work runs in a worker thread: the event loop must never wait on the state lock.

CameraEventInput.title: CameraEventInput
CameraEventInput.description: Legacy adapter requires real plate fields; old demo-only payloads are rejected.

ChangeSet.title: ChangeSet
ChangeSet.description: Entities changed after a cursor. reset=true: reload the snapshot (restart, gap or unknown cursor).

CommandGeometry.title: CommandGeometry
CommandGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry (WGS84, longitude first) of a spatial mission command.

DeviceCapabilityInput.title: DeviceCapabilityInput
DeviceCapabilityInput.description: Client-observed browser capabilities and battery for pilot measurement; no location.

EventWeights.title: EventWeights
EventWeights.description: Evidence weight of each recorded event category in the Bayesian update.

MissionCommand.title: MissionCommand
MissionCommand.description: A human spatial order, distinct from a device command; can_execute is always false.

MissionCommandAction.title: MissionCommandAction
MissionCommandAction.description: Field action by the addressed guard; event_id makes retries (double tap, offline resend) idempotent.

MissionCommandPreview.title: MissionCommandPreview
MissionCommandPreview.description: Who is in the area now. Only fresh positions count as inside; stale/unknown are listed apart.

PaperScanInput.title: PaperScanInput
PaperScanInput.description: A later entry of the printed backup patrol form; always method=paper and trust=low.

PatrolGameSettings.title: PatrolGameSettings
PatrolGameSettings.description: Every organisation-specific input of the patrol security game; edited in the UI, approved by Herasat.

PatrolStrategy.title: PatrolStrategy
PatrolStrategy.description: Optimal randomized coverage with its full arithmetic; advisory only.

PositionObservation.title: PositionObservation
PositionObservation.description: Raw stored observation with its quality evidence; live=false points never moved the live position.

PositionReceipt.title: PositionReceipt
PositionReceipt.description: What the server did with one observation: durable first, then accepted for live or history only.

RiskEventInput.title: RiskEventInput
RiskEventInput.description: Historical or manual event for the Bayesian ledger; append-only and audited.

RouteCoverageInput.title: RouteCoverageInput
RouteCoverageInput.description: Herasat's decision for one walking route: visit all stations or an optimized subset.

SecurityDossier.title: SecurityDossier
SecurityDossier.description: Facts for the AFTA security-assessment inquiry; not an assessment result.

TargetClassParameters.title: TargetClassParameters
TargetClassParameters.description: Organisation-defined consequence value and expert baseline rate for one class of target.
